description: Convert documents between formats using pandoc. Supports HTML, Markdown, DOCX, PDF, EPUB, LaTeX, ODT, RST, Org, MediaWiki, JIRA, CSV, Jupyter notebooks, and many more — any direction pandoc supports. Use this skill whenever the user wants to convert, transform, or export a document from one format to another, even if they don't mention pandoc explicitly. Triggers include: "convert this to PDF", "make a Word doc from this markdown", "export as EPUB", "turn this HTML into a PDF", "transform", "generate PDF", "render to", or any request involving document format conversion. Also use when the user wants to apply custom styling, add a table of contents, use a template, or set metadata during conversion.
